test_framework: vitest (pnpm test -> vitest run), tests in src/__tests__/
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install, 2. Run pnpm build, 3. Run pnpm test - all should pass
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No gh CLI available. Git operations work.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. README has Development section: pnpm install, pnpm run build, pnpm test.
key_patterns: Single package workspace. Node >=18 engine requirement. Uses ESM (type: module). Trusted publishing to npm via OIDC (id-token: write permission). pnpm-workspace.yaml with allowBuilds for esbuild.
directory_structure: Root level project with src/ (source + tests), dist/ (build output, gitignored), .github/workflows/ (CI/CD)
